comparison.objective: Candidate separates ceramic media from washers by screening; pr-2101 empties four concentrate bottles into a filling tank and closes a valve at the target level.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bimanual screen grasping, load sharing, limited agitation, selective retention, and reseating; pr-2101 tests repeated bottle grasping and pouring plus timing a quarter-turn valve. Tilting containers while preventing spill is shared, but selective aperture separation is not.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades recovered target mass, zero washer passage, support seating, release, and 3 s dwell, with any spill invalidating the trial; pr-2101 grades emptied bottles and final liquid level with the valve shut, with overflow, spill, bottle loss, or tank movement scoring zero. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Despite shared tilt and spill control, pr-2101 tests liquid transfer and fill-level timing, not pass-versus-retain separation of mixed rigid bodies.
